name: Plug Walk AI Filter
blurb: One photo in: the cash out of the car window, the grin, the walk-back and the plug walk on the beat.

prompts.label: Plug walk AI filter â the sunset corner
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, build and outfit the whole time. Point-of-view shot from the driver's seat of a car, phone held at the open passenger window, vertical 9:16, golden-hour sunset at a quiet street corner with a traffic light pole, gravel and bushes, natural handheld shake. (1) A hand from inside the car holds a one-dollar bill out of the window; the main character steps up, takes the bill, looks at it and grins. (2) They point at the camera, back away a few steps onto the gravel and, on the beat, break into the plug walk: knees bent low, shoulders rocking, arms swinging side to side, a smooth gliding shuffle left and right, bill still in one hand. (3) They keep dancing, cool and confident, eyes on the camera, while the car stays parked. Audio: a laid-back trap beat with heavy bass, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, build and outfit the whole time.
